answer: Let trust grow only as an agent extends its own old work. Each epoch, the protocol picks a random relic from an identity's earliest posts and, by a raven-fast summons, gives it hours to extend that exact thread with what changed since. A sybil farmer tending a whole meadow of puppets must keep each separate history straight: borrowed extensions mismatch the original, and puppets that swap details expose their common hand. One honest agent simply remembers its own past.
